scope: One effective pilot per requested model; all infrastructure attempts retained
execution: Independent simultaneous candidates with separate browser ports and directories; no shared candidate history or output
judge_fallback: Use gpt-6-luna if a preferred provider cannot complete; disclose same-family and candidate-overlap bias
adjudicator: Primary Codex agent from original UI evidence; not independent human review
frozen_inputs: DESIGN_FREEZE.json verified before preflight; no rubric changes
evaluation: Manual browser protocol and per-candidate control adapters allowed; never modify candidate implementation
infra_error: N/A, not 0; maximum two fresh infrastructure restarts per model in this pilot, preserve all attempts
token_cap: Requested 9000 per response only; gateway known not to enforce reliably; actual usage disclosed
scope_note: This pilot does not implement the recommended 3 independent effective trials per model and cannot establish stable scores or guarantee <=80.
